title: POP MART schedules THE MONSTERS crystal-ball blind-box series for November 12
summary: POP MART's official U.S. product page specifies November 12, 2026 at 5:00 p.m. Pacific as the online release date for WHERE WISHES COME TRUE SERIES - Crystal Ball Blind Box. Six regular styles and one secret are pictured; stated materials include PVC, ABS, silicone, electronic components, metal, silica glass and water. This is a dated U.S.-market product announcement, not confirmation of mainland stock, completed sales or sales growth. Exact price/pack and mainland availability are not reverified.

title: 52TOYS lists LuLu winter blind-box keychain as November 11 new arrival
summary: 52TOYS's international storefront labels LuLu the Piggy Winter Festive Series - Everlasting Bauble Keychain a November 11, 2026 new arrival. With United States selected, the Single Box is advertised at USD 14.99; Whole Set (8 Boxes) is a separate option with an unverified total. The source lists PVC, ABS, PS and metal hardware. The listing date is not established as the original launch date. No mainland-China stock, unit sales or growth is established.
